intent: A compact pagination rail with first and last anchors, moving selection and a live page count that stays usable in narrow result panels.

layout.direction: A compact pagination landmark with a quiet result-set label, monospaced current-page caption and a fixed-height 44px travelling page rail. Keep five slots in narrow containers and seven when space allows, with first/last destinations and non-interactive ellipses. The current page has a clear 3:1 outline; Previous and Next remain separate 44px controls below. Keep neutral graphite surfaces, readable 14px page labels and 12px caption type.
layout.container: Fill the parent up to 672px with 16px padding; rail slot count responds to its own measured width.

motion.entrance: Enter the navigation landmark with opacity and an 8px rise over 280ms.
motion.interaction: Keep the travelling rail and shared selected plate at 260/280ms. New/retiring slots use owned 260ms vertical entries/exits with 120ms opacity. The keyed current caption enters over 180ms without retaining old captions.
motion.reduced: Subscribe independently to live prefers-reduced-motion changes, including retiring slots. Stop and settle owned controls immediately, retire old copies, remove projection transforms and render a static selected plate.

responsive.rules: Seven slots at rail width >=320px, five below; show all pages for smaller totals. Rail remains one 44px row; header can wrap and the nav controls retain 44px targets.

accessibility: Use native buttons and form controls with visible 2px focus rings.
Provide labels, meaningful states and polite feedback where actions update content.
Keep IDs instance-scoped with useId; support multiple instances and empty custom data.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no automatic action or navigation.
Exiting slots are immediately inert and aria-hidden. Preserve clicked page focus through window movement and restore to the clamped selection when a controlled update removes a focused page.
One polite status caption announces the current page; its animated visual copy is aria-hidden. Large visual labels are compact but accessible names retain full numbers.

content.defaults: Use the realistic default content from the source; expose content and collection inputs as typed props.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the result set and navigation landmark.

props.name: page
props.description: Controlled one-based page, clamped to available bounds. Without onPageChange, navigation is read-only.

props.name: pageCount
props.description: Finite non-negative integer total, capped at Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Invalid values show no pages. Large visible page labels stay compact with full accessible names and titles.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Synchronous request for a valid different one-based destination. The host acknowledges controlled requests and owns result loading or navigation.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

content.state: Uncontrolled selection updates locally. Controlled selection calls onPageChange and waits for the host. Clamp invalid selection and totals safely; zero disables both navigation buttons.

avoid: Remote images, fake network success or hidden external dependencies.
Decorative status badges, gradients as filler, low-contrast text.
Unlabelled controls, hover-only functionality, overflow at 320px.
contract: Preserve PaginationWindowProps and the named PaginationWindow export. Use defaultPage for local state or page with onPageChange for controlled acknowledgement. Controlled navigation without a writer is disabled.

Normalize finite page totals to non-negative integers up to Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and clamp the current page to the available range. Invalid totals show no pages; invalid selected positions use page one when pages exist. Do not notify for a current-page or out-of-range request.

Keep the bounded five/seven-slot page window, 44px rail height and actual first/last destinations. Size from the rail container with ResizeObserver; retained page controls animate through intermediate horizontal positions.

Use native buttons and exact one-based accessible page names. Mark the actual current destination with aria-current=page and expose the current caption through a status. Ellipses and retiring slots are non-interactive; retired copies are hidden and inert.
Keep page focus when the window resizes or the host clamps a removed page. If no enabled destination remains, focus the outlined navigation landmark. Do not take focus from an outside control.

Keep large visible page labels within their targets using compact labels and scientific fallback, with full page numbers in accessible names and titles. The current-page outline meets at least 3:1 contrast.
Callbacks are synchronous navigation requests. The host owns route changes, result loading and persistence; a refused controlled request retains the actual current page.
